name: Orbismo
description:
Orbismo is a collaborative world-building platform for AI. Keep track of the people, places, events, and details that make up your world, then draw on that knowledge in any Claude conversation instead of re-explaining it every time.

Connect Orbismo and Claude reads and writes a connected world you own: create and update entities (people, places, events, references, rules, and more), map relationships between them, browse a chronological timeline, and search across entities and long-form lore. Give a world its own standing instructions so Claude behaves the way you want inside it. Organize separate worlds for your life, your work, and the stories you're writing, and share a world to build together with your team.

Getting started is free. Create an Orbismo account at https://orbismo.com — new accounts get a coupon code for a free world.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Orbismo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Orbismo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.orbismo.com/api/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Orbismo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Orbismo lists 21 MCP tools, including audit_world, create_entities, create_entity_lore, create_relationships, delete_entity, delete_entity_lore, delete_relationship, get_entities, get_entity_lore, get_timeline, get_world_context, and get_world_instructions.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Orbismo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Orbismo in creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Clipkit, Backstage, Interior Company, vivideo-prompt-builder, and gpt-war.
Orbismo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Orbismo is developed by GhzLab, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
